monte_carlo._comment_: Exposure simulation (`dev_main --simulate`, NUMERAIRE_MC_PATHS / NUMERAIRE_MC_SEED). Separate from monte_carlo_pricer below: full paths across the exposure grid, not a single step to maturity.

monte_carlo_pricer._comment_: MonteCarloGbmEuropeanPricer (NUMERAIRE_MC_PRICER_PATHS / NUMERAIRE_MC_PRICER_SEED). European payoffs are sampled at maturity in one exact GBM step, so paths only set the sampling error (~1/sqrt(paths), reported per mark in remarks). The fixed seed keeps a re-run of the same day reproducible.

binomial._comment_: CRR tree (PricingEngineType::kBinomialTree). Read by BinomialBlackScholesEquityPricer (overridable via NUMERAIRE_BINOMIAL_STEPS). American early exercise is checked at every tree step (dt = T / default_steps); not a Bermudan calendar.

database._comment_: Wired up in Stage 2+ once SQLite repository ships.

market_data._comment_: Wired up in Stage 3+ once Polygon provider ships.

simulation._comment_: Monte Carlo / CCR exposure grid pattern (offsets in days; dates built at run time).
